queries: Fixed expanded 8 strict, same-RGB forks in public SAGE train routes of development geometry 839992. Both supplied original instructions include one STOP fork. Reuse actual native text without route or target IDs at search.
mapping: Collect successful archived A* demonstrations, one per same route (archive order then old then expanded), raw action windows .5s, keyframe each 4th and last, index its actual executed action (incl STOP) and a whole-route natural-language caption. For historical traces use only independently vetted original navigation rewrite in offline_relabel registration. New physical fork demos use previously frozen original supplied instruction. Gallery captions describe intended destination, not guaranteed image visibility. Trace/coordinate and endpoint truth only to construct splits, measure costs, and evaluate.

protocols.fixed: Exclude all eight evaluated route pairs and all corresponding starting XY positions (any yaw) from development gallery. Same map pre-built, reused across query pairs.
protocols.leave_pair_out: Excludes both queried routes and all demos at their start XY for each pair; permits demos from other evaluation routes. Exploratory transductive support coverage.
protocols.cross_scene: Only demos from 840139,841012,841150. No local map, source-gallery transfer control.
protocols.no_gallery: Training-scene most-common executed action on same retained keyframes, no room/query information.

policy: Read only instruction and current drone RGB, plus allowed fixed demo memory of RGB descriptors, supplied text, and next actions. Rank demonstrations first by Jaccard overlap of frozen grounder._tokens(_english_destination(command)) (fallback to _goal_text if parser empty); ties by least RMS to RGB query among keyframes; use its closest keyframe executed action. Descriptor = bilinear 16x12 RGB /255 (no tunable parameters). Equal distances by archive order and earlier keyframe. Image-only uses all gallery frames and ignores text. Text-only picks first best demonstration and its first recorded action. Wrong gallery labels cyclic shift by 1; query language swap evaluated against both the supplied and original label. Never use instance names, route name, coordinates or reference path for action decisions.
metrics: Per protocol: all 16 decisions/8 pairs, exact both actions, changed action across identical RGB, genuine correct instance retrieval among all arms and oracle-present coverage, plus unique supports, public ids, acquisition windows flight time, flown length, RGB bytes and descriptor size. Pure CPU. No navigation SR claim. If no library carried for the room then independent local gallery not available; abstain counted against denominator.
